BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
NANKING. L. SHANGHAI.
No. S. B. D. 2464.
" " 8 - 6 - 31.
8th. June 1931.

Sir,

You will have seen the news item in the
"North China Daily News" of 4th. June to the
effect that a foreigner, stated to be of Russian
nationality, had fired on and killed two Chinese
gendarmes near Quinsan on the Shanghai-Nanking
Railway at about 10 p.m. on the evening of
1st. June and that he had been arrested the
following morning.

I have strong reasons for believing that
the foreigner who was arrested is a British
subject named William John Hay Thorburn, aged 19,
though whether he was concerned with the alleged
shooting is another matter. Thorburn left his
home on 31st. May and has not yet returned, and
I have therefore the honour to request that I may
receive the assistance of the Municipal Police in
investigating the matter.

Captain R.M.J. Martin,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Consul-General.

先生，

阁下想必已看到6月4日《字林西报》上的新闻简讯，大意是：6月1日晚10时许，在京沪铁路昆山附近，一名据称为俄国国籍的外国人开枪打死两名中国宪兵，并于次日上午被捕。

我有充分理由相信，被捕的外国人是一名名为 William John Hay Thorburn 的英国臣民，年19岁，尽管他是否涉嫌上述枪击案则是另一回事。Thorburn 于5月31日离家，至今未归，因此我荣幸地请求得到工部局警务处在调查此事上的协助。

致
上海公共租界工部局
警务处处长
R.M.J. Martin 上尉。

我荣幸地成为，
先生，

Subject (in full) foreigner arrested for alleged shooting at Weiting

Made by Supt Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Henry Robertson exor.

I ~~M~~ made enquiries this morning at the Public Safety
regarding the foreigner who was arrested near Weiting for firing
at and wounding two soldiers. Col. Ohrn had no knowledge of the
affair and referred me to the Railway Police. Mr. Deng Chu
Yu Chief of the Railway Police after telephing to Quinsan
informed me that the soldiers or Military Police who effected
the arrest of the foreigner had been transferred to Nanking
that they took the prisoner with them and that the prisoner
is now detained at the Military Police Headquarters at Nanking
(南京憲兵司令部).

Superintendent.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch No. G - Section,
No. S. D. D. 2444.
Date June 5. 1931.

Subject (in full) Shooting of Railway Police by Foreigner alleged to be
Russian, but suspected to be a British Subject,
named William John Hay-Thorburn.

Made by D. I. Ross Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.O.I.

With reference to the article entitled "Russian
arrested for killing Railway Police", which appeared in
the Shun Pao and other local vernaculars on June 3, 1931,
enquiries show that at 7 p.m. June 1, sixteen soldiers of
the 4th Company, 1st Battalion, 1st Regiment of the
Military Police, left their headquarters at Quinsan (崑山)
and proceeded by train to Weiting (唯亭). Here they
divided into groups of four, one party proceeding along
the railway towards Chen-I (正儀) Station which is situated
between Quinsan and Weiting. About 10 p.m. when about
3 li west of Chen-I the soldiers observed a fairly tall
man walking along the track towards them. They challenged
him and asked for the password but received no reply.
They then ordered him to halt for the purpose of searching
him. The man obeyed and raised his arms. Two
soldiers named respectively Li Kuo-zai (李國才) and Sung
Li-sung (沈利生) approached him and by the light of
a flashlamp carried by the first named revealed the man
to be a foreigner. As they attempted to search him
the man suddenly dropped his arms and fired three or four
shots with a pistol which he had in his hand wounding
Li Kuo-zai in the chest and Sung Li-sung in the head and
liver. The other two soldiers, who were following
some little distance behind, on hearing the firing ran
up to investigate but the foreigner had made good his
escape in the darkness. A search of the spot resulted
in the finding of a loaded pistol, reported to be a
"Browning" together with a leather ammunition belt contain-
ing a number of pistol cartridges and several note-books.

事由（全称） 铁路警察遭一名疑似为俄国人、但被怀疑为英国臣民的外国人枪击案，该人名叫 William John Hay-Thorburn。

由 D. I. Ross 撰写 由 Henry Robertson C.O.I. 转呈

关于1931年6月3日刊登在《申报》及其他本地中文报刊上题为“俄国人因杀害铁路警察被捕”的文章，经查询显示：6月1日晚7时，军警第一团第一营第四连的十六名士兵离开昆山总部，乘火车前往唯亭。在此处，他们分成四人一组，其中一组沿铁路向位于昆山和唯亭之间的正仪（Chen-I）车站方向行进。晚上10点左右，在正仪以西约3里处，士兵们发现一个身材相当高大的男子沿着铁轨向他们走来。他们喝问并要求对口令，但未获回应。随后他们命令其停下以便搜身。该男子服从并举起双手。两名分别名为李国才（Li Kuo-zai）和沈利生（Sung Li-sung）的士兵走近他，借助前者携带的手电筒光亮，发现该男子为外国人。正当他们试图搜身时，该男子突然放下手臂，用手中的手枪开了三四枪，击中李国才胸部，以及沈利生的头部和肝脏。另外两名跟在后面稍远处的士兵听到枪声后跑上前查看，但该外国人已在黑暗中逃脱。对现场的搜查发现了一支装有子弹的手枪，据报为“勃朗宁”牌，以及一条装有数发手枪子弹的皮质弹药带和几本笔记本。

A search was then made for the assailant and during the
early hours of June 2, a foreigner, who is suspected of
having done the shooting, was apprehended on the railway
track near Weiting. Upon being searched he was found to
be in possession of a loaded pistol and a handkerchief
bearing the following inscriptions "Sea Scout Troop".
He was taken to Quinsan where he was detained until the
afternoon of June 2, when he was removed to Nanking under
escort. He is reported to be at present detained in the
headquarters of the Defence Commissioner there.
The two wounded men were brought to Shanghai
on the morning of June 2, and were admitted to St. Luke's
Hospital where they are at present lying in a critical
condition.
In connection with this affair enquiries made
by members of this office among the villagers of Quinsan
disclose the information that at about 4 p.m. on June 1,
a foreigner answering to the description of William John
Thorburn, (Memo No.340) and who was subsequently
identified from a photograph by the wife of Tsang Ah-sing
(張合興), owner of a dry goods store, arrived in
Quinsan walking along the railway track from the direction
of Shanghai. He was carrying a small bundle and was
wearing a pair of dark blue trousers with two red braids
down the outside of each leg. He spoke Chinese fairly
well and after purchasing some sweetmeats from the above-
mentioned shop he departed in a westerly direction along
the railway. He was later seen in the custody of the

随后对袭击者展开搜寻，在6月2日凌晨，一名涉嫌实施枪击的外国人在唯亭附近的铁轨上被捕。经搜身，发现其持有一支装有子弹的手帕和一块印有“Sea Scout Troop”（海上童子军团）字样的手帕。他被带往昆山，被拘留至6月2日下午，随后在押解下被送往南京。据报道，他目前被拘押在南京卫戍司令总部。

与此事有关，本处人员在昆山村民中进行的查询披露如下信息：6月1日下午4点左右，一名符合 William John Thorburn 描述（备忘录第340号）的外国人抵达昆山，他沿铁轨从上海方向走来。杂货店老板张合兴（Tsang Ah-sing）的妻子随后通过照片确认了其身份。他携带一个小包裹，穿着一条深蓝色裤子，每条裤腿外侧有两条红色饰带。他中文说得相当好，在上述店铺购买了一些糖果后，沿铁路向西离去。后来有人看到他处于

随后对袭击者展开搜寻，在6月2日凌晨，一名涉嫌实施枪击的外国人在唯亭附近的铁轨上被捕，经搜身，发现其持有一支装有子弹的手枪和一块印有“Sea Scout Troop”（海上童子军团）字样的手帕。他被带往昆山，被拘留至6月2日下午，随后在押解下被送往南京。据报道，他目前被拘押在南京卫戍司令总部。
两名伤者于6月2日上午被送往上海，入住圣路加医院，目前病情危重。
与此事有关，本处人员在昆山村民中进行的查询披露如下信息：6月1日下午4点左右，一名符合 William John Hay-Thorburn 描述（备忘录第340号）的外国人抵达昆山，他沿铁轨从上海方向走来。杂货店老板张合兴（Tsung Ah-sing）的妻子随后通过照片确认了其身份。他携带一个小包裹，穿着一条深蓝色裤子，每条裤腿外侧有两条红色饰带。他中文说得相当好，在上述店铺购买了一些糖果后，沿铁路向西离去。后来有人看到他处于

A pair of red braided blue pants which William
